The task is to find the difference in the time spans of these diagrams in seconds.

The July 2020 paper is from July 3, 2020, and also discusses fast radio bursts. Both papers are by the same set of authors, which should make cross-referencing easier.

For the March 2021 paper, I found the X-ray time profile on page 5. The time span mentioned is 3.5 seconds. In the July 2020 paper, the burst-1 diagram on page 6 shows a time span of 2.8 seconds.

To find the difference, I subtract the July 2020 time span from the March 2021 time span: 3.5 seconds - 2.8 seconds = 0.7 seconds.
